sideB.text:
NEW VOLUNTEERS FROM THE HAVENS HAVE DECIDED TO JOIN US.

mechanics.whenRead: PAUSE. Drawn during step 2 of June setup, which stops on this card. Read side B during step 2 at the end of the first June game, then continue the Legacy deck.
rules: New volunteers from the havens join.
mechanics.notes: The volunteer line is set in capitals above the door instruction. 44 and 49 are in white boxes with red type. What is inside them is not printed on this card.
